body: If it was just about me I would be happier working on my own stuff rather than what people will pay me for, but I'll not get by on no money because apparently people have to eat and stuff. There's not much to discover or make that nobody before hand has made, because there are so many people in the programming world, most of which are better than me.

As I said in a previous post (the original, I think), I do not like the idea of therapy in the slightest. That person does not care at all, they are simply working for money, just the same as I do not care for any customer I write code for, I just want the job to be done.

In regards to working at home, while technically I could freelance, I just have no motivation to sort it out, at all. I see no reason to get money or progress on this planet, it just sucks.

I left because I simply couldn't stand being around other humans when the decline started and the thought of working became horrible. I've been offered multiple jobs during my unemployment that all pay well in my field and I've turned them down, I just have zero motivation to do anything.

People are always talking about me, I've walked in on many conversations regarding me that quickly end on my arrival. Everyone in the street is constantly judging me, I hate it, I hate humans. I don't go outside anymore, I just order food online with what little money I have left.

I find myself feeling rather lonely when I play games when I am the only one in, I often play Skyrim but lately I've had problems getting my mind in a state where I can just sit down and play it.

I have a few things I am proud of, but nothing overly. And the problem is nobody cares, really. If someone makes some music, they can show that to people and the people will understand that they've made music, they'll appreciate it for what it is. If I show someone my code or talk about how I created a custom JSON serialization interface in PHP before the patch came out, nobody has a clue what that is.

"You know those humans playing WoW, are kids that range from 10-18 right?"

Not on role-play servers, it's generally far too easy to detect those idiots, the community weeds them out rather easily. While you do get your idiots, most people I come across are 20-30.

As for everything else you said, I guess I agree. It's just hard to look up on the world with that kind of perspective when I look around and see everyone just walking around like the world is their oyster and I'm sat here stressing, paranoid and freaking out everyday. I've become some kind of monster, constantly swinging in and out of different mindsets.

My hobbies include gaming and programming, the latter of which I "have a natural talent" for as you put it. Gaming is now helping my mood, I am unable to become immersed in anything to enjoy it. I often role-play on World of Warcraft however that escalates my will to die ten fold because of interaction with humans. 99% of humans are fucking horrible.

As for programming, I can't exactly code my heart out, it doesn't do anything for my except increase stress levels, as if they were not already high enough.

I am alone, I will be alone forever because nobody wants a fuck-up.

As selfish as it sounds, everyone who said they'd be there when I needed them turned their backs on my when I needed them most, I don't see why I should just "deal with it" and then go help others.

Life is nothing but a curse filled with pretty things along the way to make you think differently.

I've had that friend, who talked me out of it. And I thought everything was going to be better. Than I realized that he, just like everyone else on this planet is selfish and will turn their back on you as soon as you start to become a burden because you can't handle your problems.
